<!-- One or two sentences: what a user or contributor gets that they did not have. -->

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Every commit is a conventional commit, signed off (`git commit -s`), with a `Co-Authored-By` trailer if an assistant wrote it
- [ ] New behaviour has a test under `tests/` and its docs are updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under the unreleased version, if a user would notice
